notes.title: Rewind OST Available!
notes.content: Rewind's composer, Tyler Shaw aka Slightly Basic, has put together the game's soundtrack and made it available on Bandcamp. Pick up the mellow melodies of Purgatory over at: https://slightlybasic.bandcamp.com/album/rewind-ost

notes.title: Trading cards, badges, emoticons and backgrounds are up!
notes.content:
Rewind now has all of the Steam perks enabled, sorry about the wait! The game now has 7 trading cards, 5 emoticons and 3 backgrounds to collect featuring the player, weapons, enemies and environments.

Drop by Purgatory sometime and grab them!
